applied_history_rule: Migration bytes already present in an applied registry are immutable. No filename, byte, digest, order, or registry value may be rewritten. A semantic delta is always a new forward migration.
reservation_rules: A lane may use only its reserved range.
A reservation is not permission to create a migration or edit migrations/manifest.json.
Each migration requires its own card ownership, immutable commit and tree, tests, evidence, rollback, and independent review.
The integration owner regenerates migrations/manifest.json from reviewed immutable files and never imports the shared dirty manifest.
Fresh install, historical 0012 upgrade, candidate 0019 upgrade, up/down/up, digest-prefix, dependency-order, and duplicate-number tests must pass.
Qualification migration 0021 cannot precede CapAuth delta 0020.
Unused numbers remain reserved and are not compacted or reassigned without a new reviewed reservation version.
